title_tag: 大疆之后，又来了“四小龙”：中国为什么连 3D 打印机也卷到全球第一？—— 英国《经济学人》外刊讲解第1208天
h1: 大疆之后，又来了“四小龙”：中国为什么连 3D 打印机也卷到全球第一？
category: 英国《经济学人》外刊讲解 第1208天
nav_hint: China has captured the market for hobbyist 3D printers

headline.en_html: China has <mark class="voc">captured</mark> the market for <mark class="voc">hobbyist</mark> 3D printers
headline.zh: 中国已占领业余爱好者 3D 打印机市场

notes.en: capture (v.) means to gain control of something, especially a market
notes.ctx: 中国企业已经拿下了业余爱好者 3D 打印机这个市场的主导权。
notes.ex1: The company hopes to capture a larger share of the European market. 这家公司希望占据更大的欧洲市场份额。
notes.ex2: Her speech captured the attention of millions of viewers. 她的演讲吸引了数百万观众的注意。

notes.en: hobbyist (n.) means a person who enjoys doing a particular activity in their free time
notes.ctx: 买来放家里玩的个人用户，而不是工厂里的专业客户——本文的战场就在这一块。
notes.ex1: The camera is designed for hobbyists rather than professional photographers. 这款相机是为业余爱好者而非专业摄影师设计的。
notes.ex2: Many hobbyists turn their interests into small businesses. 许多业余爱好者把自己的兴趣发展成了小生意。

paragraphs.en_html: The fastest-growing industrial product in China today is not the electric vehicle, lithium-ion battery or even <mark class="voc">humanoid</mark> robot. It is the <mark class="voc">humble</mark> 3D printer for hobbyists. Once <mark class="voc">geeky</mark> <mark class="voc">curios</mark>, 3D printers have quietly become one of China’s most successful <mark class="voc">consumer electronics</mark>. Exports of the machines grew by 90% in the first half of this year. In the past decade China’s global market share has risen from 19% to 96%, ending the dominance of Western firms.
paragraphs.zh: 如今，中国增长最快的工业产品不是电动汽车、锂离子电池，甚至也不是人形机器人，而是看似不起眼、面向业余爱好者的3D打印机。3D打印机曾经只是科技极客眼中的新奇玩意儿，如今却悄然成为中国最成功的消费电子产品之一。今年上半年，这类设备的出口增长了90%。过去十年间，中国在全球市场的份额从19%攀升至96%，终结了西方企业的主导地位。

notes.en: humanoid (adj.) means having an appearance or structure similar to that of a human
notes.ctx: humanoid robot指人形机器人，即外形或结构模仿人类的机器人。
notes.ex1: The company unveiled a humanoid robot capable of climbing stairs. 这家公司发布了一款能够爬楼梯的人形机器人。
notes.ex2: Scientists are developing humanoid machines to assist elderly people. 科学家正在研发帮助老年人的人形机器。

notes.en: humble (adj.) means simple and ordinary, without appearing impressive or important
notes.zh: 普通的；不起眼的；朴素的
notes.ctx: 强调3D打印机看似不起眼，却取得了令人意外的商业成功。
notes.ex1: The restaurant began as a humble roadside food stall. 这家餐厅最初只是一个不起眼的路边小吃摊。
notes.ex2: A humble invention can sometimes transform an entire industry. 一项看似普通的发明有时能够改变整个行业。

notes.en: geeky (adj.) means associated with people who are extremely interested in technology or specialized subjects
notes.zh: 极客式的；科技迷的；带有技术宅气质的
notes.ctx: 形容早期3D打印机主要吸引热衷技术的小众人群。
notes.ex1: He has a geeky fascination with vintage computers. 他对老式计算机有一种极客式的痴迷。
notes.ex2: What once seemed geeky has now become fashionable. 曾经显得很极客的东西，如今已经变得时髦。

notes.en: curio (n.) means a small, unusual object that is interesting because it is rare or strange
notes.zh: 稀奇的小物件；古玩；新奇玩意儿
notes.ctx: geeky curios指过去只让科技爱好者感兴趣的新奇设备。
notes.ex1: The little shop was filled with curios collected from around the world. 这家小店摆满了从世界各地收集来的稀奇物件。
notes.ex2: Early smart devices were often treated as expensive curios. 早期智能设备常常被当作昂贵的新奇玩意儿。

notes.en: consumer electronics (n.) means electronic devices designed for everyday use by individual consumers
notes.ctx: 3D打印机已经成为中国成功的消费电子产品之一。
notes.ex1: Smartphones remain an important part of the consumer electronics industry. 智能手机仍然是消费电子行业的重要组成部分。
notes.ex2: Competition has made consumer electronics more affordable. 竞争使消费电子产品变得更加实惠。

paragraphs.en_html: The personal 3D-printing market is now <mark class="voc">split among</mark> the “four little dragons of Shenzhen”, says Chris Connery of Context, a London-based <mark class="voc">market-intelligence</mark> firm. Creality, Anycubic, Elegoo and the industry’s leader, Bambu Lab, <mark class="voc">reign supreme</mark> globally (see chart). Their success shows, yet again, how <mark class="voc">fierce</mark> competition in China combined with generous government support can help improve quality and <mark class="voc">drive down</mark> export prices, making Chinese products <mark class="voc">hard to beat</mark>.
paragraphs.zh: 伦敦市场情报公司Context的克里斯·康纳里表示，如今个人3D打印市场已被“深圳四小龙”瓜分。创想三维（Creality）、纵维立方（Anycubic）、智能派（Elegoo），以及行业领军企业拓竹科技（Bambu Lab），在全球市场占据着绝对优势（见图表）。它们的成功再次表明，中国国内的激烈竞争，加上政府的大力支持，能够推动产品质量提升、出口价格下降，使中国产品极具竞争力，难有对手。

notes.en: split among (phr.) means to be divided or shared between several people, groups or organizations
notes.ctx: 个人3D打印市场主要由深圳四家企业占据。
notes.ex1: The profits were split among the three business partners. 利润由三位商业合伙人分配。
notes.ex2: The market is increasingly split among a handful of technology giants. 这个市场正日益被少数几家科技巨头瓜分。

notes.en: market intelligence (n.) means information and analysis about markets, customers and competitors used to make business decisions
notes.zh: 市场情报；市场信息分析
notes.ctx: Context是一家收集和分析行业市场信息的研究公司。
notes.ex1: Reliable market intelligence helps companies identify new opportunities. 可靠的市场情报有助于企业发现新机遇。
notes.ex2: The firm invested heavily in market intelligence before entering Asia. 这家公司在进入亚洲市场前投入大量资金进行市场情报分析。

notes.en: reign supreme (phr.) means to be the most powerful, successful or important in a particular area
notes.zh: 占据绝对优势；称霸；处于至高地位
notes.ctx: 深圳四家3D打印机企业在全球个人市场占据主导地位。
notes.ex1: For decades, traditional television reigned supreme in home entertainment. 几十年来，传统电视一直主导着家庭娱乐领域。
notes.ex2: In the luxury market, a few established brands still reign supreme. 在奢侈品市场，少数老牌品牌依然占据绝对优势。

notes.en: fierce (adj.) means very strong, intense or aggressive
notes.zh: 激烈的；猛烈的；竞争性极强的
notes.ctx: fierce competition指中国3D打印机企业之间的激烈竞争。
notes.ex1: Competition for skilled engineers has become increasingly fierce. 对技术工程师的争夺已经变得越来越激烈。
notes.ex2: The two companies are engaged in a fierce price war. 这两家公司正陷入激烈的价格战。

notes.en: drive down (phr.) means to cause prices, costs or other amounts to become lower
notes.ctx: 激烈竞争和政府支持共同推动中国3D打印机出口价格下降。
notes.ex1: Mass production has helped drive down the cost of batteries. 大规模生产有助于降低电池成本。
notes.ex2: Online competition is driving down prices across the industry. 线上竞争正在推动整个行业降价。

notes.en: hard to beat (phr.) means difficult to defeat or surpass because of strong advantages
notes.zh: 难以击败的；极具竞争力的
notes.ctx: 中国产品凭借质量和价格优势，让其他国家的竞争对手难以匹敌。
notes.ex1: At this price, the quality of the product is hard to beat. 以这个价格来说，这款产品的质量很难被超越。
notes.ex2: The combination of speed and convenience is hard to beat. 速度与便利性的结合很难有其他选择能够匹敌。

paragraphs.en_html: The printers work by building objects <mark class="voc">layer by layer</mark>, usually by <mark class="voc">extruding</mark> <mark class="voc">molten</mark> plastic. Invented by Chuck Hull, an American, in 1983, they long remained expensive, unreliable and difficult to use. Today they routinely sell for a little more than $500 and have the <mark class="voc">sleek</mark> aluminium <mark class="voc">finish</mark> of an Apple computer. <mark class="voc">Comparable</mark> <mark class="voc">entry-level</mark> printers from Western firms start at more than double the price. Artificial intelligence allows users to create print designs for such things as tools, parts or toys by describing them in natural language rather than using complicated design-software. Just as Chinese factories helped to turn drones into <mark class="voc">recreational</mark> devices (as well as <mark class="voc">game-changers</mark> in warfare) by achieving large-scale production at low cost, so they are now doing with 3D printers.
paragraphs.zh: 3D打印机通过逐层堆叠材料来制造物体，通常是将熔融塑料挤出成形。3D打印机由美国人查克·赫尔于1983年发明，但在很长一段时间里，这类设备一直价格昂贵、性能不可靠，而且操作困难。如今，它们的售价通常只比500美元略高，外观则采用了类似苹果电脑的光滑铝制饰面。西方企业生产的同类入门级打印机，起售价却是这一价格的两倍多。人工智能让用户不必使用复杂的设计软件，只需用自然语言描述需求，就能为工具、零部件或玩具等物品创建打印设计。正如中国工厂曾通过低成本的大规模生产，将无人机变成大众娱乐设备（同时也使其成为改变战争格局的利器），如今它们正以同样的方式推动3D打印机的普及。

notes.en: layer by layer (phr.) means one layer at a time, with each new layer added to the previous one
notes.ctx: 3D打印机通过逐层堆叠材料来制造立体物体。
notes.ex1: The cake was carefully assembled layer by layer. 这个蛋糕被一层一层地精心组装起来。
notes.ex2: Trust is built layer by layer through repeated acts of honesty. 信任是通过一次又一次的诚实行为逐渐建立起来的。

notes.en: extrude (v.) means to force a material through a small opening to give it a particular shape
notes.ctx: 3D打印机将熔融塑料从喷嘴挤出，形成一层层打印材料。
notes.ex1: The machine extrudes plastic into long, thin tubes. 这台机器将塑料挤压成长而细的管子。
notes.ex2: Factories extrude metal through specially shaped openings. 工厂将金属通过特殊形状的模具孔挤压成形。

notes.en: molten (adj.) means heated to a very high temperature so that it becomes liquid
notes.ctx: molten plastic指3D打印机加热熔化后用于打印的塑料材料。
notes.ex1: Molten lava flowed slowly down the mountainside. 熔融的岩浆沿着山坡缓缓流下。
notes.ex2: The workers poured molten metal into a large mould. 工人们将熔化的金属倒入一个大模具中。

notes.en: sleek (adj.) means smooth, shiny and modern in appearance
notes.zh: 光滑时尚的；线条流畅的；精致的
notes.ctx: 形容现代3D打印机具有类似苹果电脑的精致、流畅外观。
notes.ex1: The new electric car has a sleek and futuristic design. 这款新电动汽车拥有流畅而充满未来感的设计。
notes.ex2: She chose a sleek black laptop for her new office. 她为新办公室挑选了一台外观精致的黑色笔记本电脑。

notes.en: finish (n.) means the appearance or texture of a surface after it has been treated or decorated
notes.zh: 表面处理；饰面；表面质感
notes.ctx: aluminium finish指3D打印机外壳呈现出的铝制表面质感。
notes.ex1: The furniture has a smooth wooden finish. 这套家具采用了光滑的木质饰面。
notes.ex2: The phone comes with a polished metal finish. 这款手机采用了抛光金属饰面。

notes.en: comparable (adj.) means similar enough to something else to allow a fair comparison
notes.zh: 可比较的；类似的；同等水平的
notes.ctx: comparable entry-level printers指性能和定位相近、可以进行价格比较的入门级打印机。
notes.ex1: The two smartphones offer comparable performance at very different prices. 这两款智能手机性能相近，但价格差异很大。
notes.ex2: No comparable product was available on the market at the time. 当时市场上还没有同类产品。

notes.en: entry-level (adj.) means designed for beginners or people with little experience
notes.ctx: entry-level printers指适合初学者使用的基础款3D打印机。
notes.ex1: This entry-level camera is ideal for beginners. 这款入门级相机非常适合初学者。
notes.ex2: The company offers several entry-level positions for recent graduates. 这家公司为应届毕业生提供了多个初级职位。

notes.en: recreational (adj.) means connected with activities that people do for enjoyment rather than work
notes.zh: 娱乐性的；消遣的；休闲的
notes.ctx: recreational devices指普通消费者用于娱乐和休闲的无人机设备。
notes.ex1: The lake is popular for recreational activities such as fishing and boating. 这个湖泊因钓鱼和划船等休闲活动而受到欢迎。
notes.ex2: Recreational drones have become increasingly affordable. 娱乐用无人机的价格已经变得越来越亲民。

notes.en: game-changer (n.) means something that completely changes a situation or the way something is done
notes.zh: 颠覆性事物；改变局面的因素
notes.ctx: game-changers in warfare指无人机对现代战争方式产生了颠覆性影响。
notes.ex1: The invention of the smartphone was a game-changer for communication. 智能手机的发明彻底改变了人们的通信方式。
notes.ex2: Affordable batteries could be a game-changer for renewable energy. 价格低廉的电池可能彻底改变可再生能源行业。

paragraphs.en_html: For most of its history, consumer 3D printing had an <mark class="voc">unspoken</mark> <mark class="voc">cost of entry</mark>: patience. Getting a printer to actually work often took longer than using it. Bed leveling, <mark class="voc">calibration</mark>, and <mark class="voc">trial-and-error</mark> <mark class="voc">troubleshooting</mark> weren’t occasional annoyances; they were simply part of owning one. That was the deal, and for years, nobody in the industry seriously challenged it. Part of Bambu Lab’s different approach can be <mark class="voc">traced back to</mark> its <mark class="voc">founding team</mark>. Several of its engineers came from DJI, the drone manufacturer, with backgrounds in robotics and consumer electronics. Drones present a similar design challenge to 3D printers: they’re <mark class="voc">mechanically</mark> complex, but successful consumer products need to be usable without specialized training. Bambu Lab’s founders had already <mark class="voc">worked through</mark> that kind of problem before applying it to printing.
paragraphs.zh: 在消费级3D打印技术发展的绝大部分历史中，进入这一领域都有一项不言而喻的门槛：耐心。让一台打印机真正正常运转，往往比实际使用它还要费时间。打印平台调平、校准，以及反复试错的故障排查，并不是偶尔出现的小麻烦，而是拥有一台3D打印机就必须接受的日常现实。这就是当时行业默认的规则，多年来几乎没有人认真尝试改变它。拓竹科技之所以采取不同的产品设计思路，部分原因可以追溯到它的创始团队。团队中的几位工程师来自无人机制造商大疆，拥有机器人技术和消费电子领域的工作背景。无人机和3D打印机面临着类似的设计难题：它们的机械结构都十分复杂，但要成为成功的消费产品，就必须让没有专业训练的普通人也能轻松使用。拓竹科技的创始人在将这一理念应用于3D打印之前，就已经解决过类似的问题。

notes.en: unspoken (adj.) means understood or accepted without being directly expressed in words
notes.zh: 未说出口的；不言而喻的；心照不宣的
notes.ctx: unspoken cost of entry指行业默认存在、却很少被明确提及的使用门槛。
notes.ex1: There was an unspoken agreement that nobody would mention the mistake. 大家心照不宣地达成了一项共识：谁也不提那个错误。
notes.ex2: Many workplaces have unspoken rules about how employees should behave. 许多职场都有关于员工行为方式的不成文规定。

notes.en: cost of entry (n.) means the money, effort or other resources required to enter a market or take part in an activity
notes.ctx: 使用早期3D打印机需要付出的隐性成本不是金钱，而是大量的时间和耐心。
notes.ex1: For small businesses, the cost of entry into the industry remains high. 对小企业来说，进入这个行业的门槛仍然很高。
notes.ex2: Online platforms have significantly reduced the cost of entry for new creators. 网络平台大幅降低了新创作者的入行门槛。

notes.en: calibration (n.) means the process of checking and adjusting a machine or instrument to make sure it works accurately
notes.ctx: 指为了确保3D打印机准确运行而进行的设备校准。
notes.ex1: Regular calibration is essential for accurate scientific measurements. 定期校准对于获得准确的科学测量结果至关重要。
notes.ex2: The camera requires calibration before it can produce reliable results. 这台相机需要经过校准才能获得可靠的拍摄结果。

notes.en: trial-and-error (adj.) means involving repeated attempts and mistakes until a successful solution is found
notes.zh: 反复试错的；通过不断尝试和纠错的
notes.ctx: trial-and-error troubleshooting指用户不断尝试不同方法，排查3D打印机的故障。
notes.ex1: Learning to cook often involves a trial-and-error process. 学习烹饪通常需要经历不断试错的过程。
notes.ex2: The engineers developed the new system through trial-and-error testing. 工程师们通过反复试错测试开发出了这套新系统。

notes.en: troubleshooting (n.) means the process of identifying and solving problems in a machine, system or device
notes.zh: 故障排查；问题诊断与解决
notes.ctx: 用户需要自行检查并解决3D打印机在使用过程中出现的各种问题。
notes.ex1: The website provides a troubleshooting guide for common technical problems. 该网站提供了一份常见技术问题的故障排查指南。
notes.ex2: Good troubleshooting skills can save technicians a great deal of time. 良好的故障排查能力可以为技术人员节省大量时间。

notes.en: trace back to (phr.) means to discover or explain the origin of something by connecting it to an earlier event or situation
notes.ctx: 拓竹科技不同的设计理念可以部分追溯到创始团队在大疆的工作经历。
notes.ex1: The origins of the festival can be traced back to ancient times. 这个节日的起源可以追溯到古代。
notes.ex2: Many of the company's problems can be traced back to poor management. 这家公司的许多问题都可以追溯到管理不善。

notes.en: founding team (n.) means the group of people who originally established a company or organization
notes.ctx: 指创立拓竹科技、并为其制定早期技术和产品方向的核心团队。
notes.ex1: The startup's founding team included three former university researchers. 这家初创公司的创始团队包括三名前大学研究人员。
notes.ex2: A strong founding team can help a young company survive difficult times. 强大的创始团队能够帮助一家年轻企业渡过难关。

notes.en: mechanically (adv.) means in a way that relates to machines, moving parts or physical mechanisms
notes.zh: 在机械结构上；从机械原理上
notes.ctx: mechanically complex指无人机和3D打印机内部机械结构复杂。
notes.ex1: The device is mechanically simple but electronically sophisticated. 这款设备机械结构简单，但电子系统十分先进。
notes.ex2: Older cars are often mechanically easier to repair. 老式汽车通常在机械结构上更容易维修。

notes.en: work through (phr.) means to deal with a problem or difficulty carefully until it is solved
notes.ctx: 拓竹科技的创始人在大疆工作期间已经解决过类似的复杂技术产品易用性问题。
notes.ex1: The team worked through several technical problems before launching the product. 团队在推出产品前逐步解决了几个技术难题。
notes.ex2: We need to work through these difficulties before making a final decision. 我们需要先解决这些困难，再作出最终决定。

paragraphs.en_html: The company also didn’t <mark class="voc">rush</mark> its first product. It spent 22 months on <mark class="voc">research and development</mark> before releasing its first printer, the X1, which launched on Kickstarter and raised about HK$55 million, or roughly $7 million, from 5,575 <mark class="voc">backers</mark>. The core of Bambu Lab’s approach is automating steps that previously required manual adjustment. Its printers include cameras, <mark class="voc">LiDAR</mark>, and gravity <mark class="voc">sensors</mark> that handle bed leveling and calibration automatically on every print, without requiring the user to understand the <mark class="voc">underlying</mark> mechanics. LatePost described the result as “a small <mark class="voc">AI-enabled</mark> robot.” One Bambu Lab owner on Reddit summarized the difference simply: “Bambu printers just work.”
paragraphs.zh: 这家公司也没有急于推出自己的第一款产品。在发布首款打印机X1之前，拓竹科技花了22个月进行研发。X1随后在众筹平台Kickstarter上推出，获得了5575名支持者的资助，共筹集约5500万港元（约合700万美元）。拓竹科技产品理念的核心，是将过去需要人工调整的操作步骤自动化。它的打印机配备了摄像头、激光雷达和重力传感器，能够在每次打印时自动完成打印平台调平和校准，而不需要用户理解背后的机械原理。《晚点》将其形容为“一台搭载人工智能的小型机器人”。Reddit上一位拓竹科技的用户则用一句简单的话概括了这种区别：“拓竹打印机就是能直接用。”

notes.en: rush (v.) means to do something too quickly, often without enough preparation or care
notes.zh: 仓促行事；匆忙完成；急于推出
notes.ctx: didn't rush its first product指拓竹科技没有急于将首款产品推向市场，而是投入了较长时间研发。
notes.ex1: The company refused to rush the launch of its new smartphone. 这家公司拒绝仓促推出新款智能手机。
notes.ex2: Don't rush your decision when so much money is involved. 涉及这么多钱时，不要仓促作出决定。

notes.en: research and development (n.) means work done by a company to create new products or improve existing ones
notes.ctx: 拓竹科技在发布首款3D打印机前进行了22个月的产品研发。
notes.ex1: The company spends billions of dollars on research and development every year. 这家公司每年在研发方面投入数十亿美元。
notes.ex2: Investment in research and development is essential for technological progress. 研发投入对于技术进步至关重要。

notes.en: backer (n.) means a person or organization that supports a project, business or idea, especially by providing money
notes.ctx: 指在 Kickstarter 上为拓竹 X1 掏钱的 5,575 名众筹支持者。
notes.ex1: The project attracted more than 10,000 backers in its first week. 该项目在第一周就吸引了超过一万名支持者。
notes.ex2: The young entrepreneur struggled to find financial backers for her idea. 这位年轻创业者很难为自己的创意找到资金支持者。

notes.en: LiDAR (n.) means a technology that uses laser light to measure distances and create detailed information about surfaces or surroundings
notes.ctx: 拓竹科技使用激光雷达等传感技术，帮助打印机自动检测和校准。
notes.ex1: Self-driving cars use LiDAR to detect objects around them. 自动驾驶汽车利用激光雷达探测周围物体。
notes.ex2: Researchers used LiDAR to create a detailed map of the forest. 研究人员利用激光雷达绘制了详细的森林地图。

notes.en: sensor (n.) means a device that detects or measures physical conditions such as movement, light or temperature
notes.ctx: gravity sensors指用于感知重力相关物理信息、辅助打印机自动运行的传感器。
notes.ex1: The phone uses sensors to detect changes in movement. 这款手机通过传感器检测运动变化。
notes.ex2: Temperature sensors help prevent the machine from overheating. 温度传感器有助于防止机器过热。

notes.en: underlying (adj.) means existing beneath the surface or forming the basic cause or structure of something
notes.ctx: underlying mechanics指3D打印机运行背后的机械原理和工作机制。
notes.ex1: Most users don't need to understand the underlying technology of their smartphones. 大多数用户不需要理解智能手机背后的底层技术。
notes.ex2: The report examines the underlying causes of the economic crisis. 这份报告研究了经济危机背后的根本原因。

notes.en: AI-enabled (adj.) means equipped with artificial intelligence technology that allows a device or system to perform certain tasks
notes.zh: 搭载人工智能的；由人工智能赋能的
notes.ctx: AI-enabled robot指利用人工智能等技术实现自动化功能的小型机器人。
notes.ex1: The hospital introduced AI-enabled equipment to assist doctors. 这家医院引进了人工智能设备来辅助医生。
notes.ex2: AI-enabled cameras can automatically recognize different objects. 搭载人工智能的摄像头能够自动识别不同物体。
